'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli settler violence]], [[Israeli incursions in the West Bank during the Gaza war]]
***More than 100 [[Israeli settlers]] attack the [[Palestine|Palestinian]] village of [[Jalud]] in the [[Israeli occupation of the West Bank|occupied]] [[West Bank]], burning two homes and injuring three [[Israeli security forces|Israeli security personnel]] while preventing a displaced Palestinian family from returning home. *[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[Piracy off the coast of Somalia]], [[Anti-piracy measures in Somalia|Anti-piracy measures]], [[Controversies of Hassan Sheikh Mohamud]]
***The [[Puntland Maritime Police Force]] successfully frees another hijacked [[oil tanker]], the ''MT Honour ​25'', following an ongoing week-long counter-piracy operation near [[Bayla]], [[Karkaar]], [[Puntland]], after it was seized by [[Piracy off the coast of Somalia|Somali pirates]] on 21 April ​around 30 nautical miles off Puntland's coast with 17 crew members on board. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/puntland-forces-rescue-another-hijacked-ship-somali-pirates-2026-09-29/ (Reuters)] [https://www.somaliguardian.com/news/somalia-news/somalia-puntland-frees-second-tanker-from-somali-pirates/ (''Somali Guardian'')]
***Five crew members aboard the ''MT Honour 25'' are killed and four more injured by the pirates before the rescue. The fatalities are three citizens of [[Pakistan]] and one each from [[India]] and [[Myanmar]]. It is the first time in over a decade that people are killed by the pirates. [https://www.aljazeera.com/amp/news/2026/9/30/somali-pirates-killed-five-crew-members-on-hijacked-tanker-officials-say (Al Jazeera)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war]]
**The [[Reserve Bank of Australia]] raises its [[cash rate]] by 0.25 percentage points to 4.60%, the highest level since 2011, citing persistently high [[inflation]] above its 2–3% [[Inflation targeting|target range]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260929-australian-central-bank-lifts-key-interest-rate-to-15-year-high (AFP via France 24)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/australias-central-bank-raises-cash-rate-15-year-peak-2026-09-29/ (Reuters)]
*[[Julius Baer Group controversies]]
**The [[Swiss Financial Market Supervisory Authority]] (FINMA) concludes its investigation into the [[Julius Baer Group]], finding serious [[Financial risk management|risk-management]] and [[anti–money laundering]] failures. FINMA orders additional capital requirements, compliance reporting through 2032, and the confiscation of about [[Swiss franc|CHF]]10 million ([[US$]]12 million) in profits. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260929-swiss-regulator-concludes-julius-baer-bank-probe (AFP via France 24)]

[https://www.usatoday.com/story/money/consumer-protection/recalls-alerts/2026/09/28/blood-pressure-medication-recall/91991981007/ (''USA Today'')]
